slides.eyebrow: SONGWRITING TRICKS YOU CAN ACTUALLY USE
slides.headline: PLAY IT AT THE [[WRONG SPEED]].
YOUR TEMPO IS AN [[ACCIDENT]].
slides.body: The speed you landed on is usually just the speed you could play it at first go. That's not a decision.

slides.headline: SO [[BREAK]] IT.
slides.body: Same chords, same melody — now take it double time. Then half. Play it stupidly fast and painfully slow.

slides.headline: SPEED IS THE WHOLE [[MOOD]].
slides.body: One song at three tempos is three different songs. Yours might have been hiding at another speed the whole time.

slides.headline: "PLEASE PLEASE ME" WAS A [[BALLAD]].
slides.body: The Beatles brought it in slow and dreary. George Martin told them to speed it up. When they nailed the faster take he leaned into the intercom: "Gentlemen, you've just made your first number one."
